# PhonerBazar Agent Guide

> Extended public context for AI agents and automated assistants interacting with the PhonerBazar website.

## Site map and discovery

- [Home](https://www.phonerbazar.store/): Official storefront.
- [Products](https://www.phonerbazar.store/products): Public catalogue entry point.
- [Brands](https://www.phonerbazar.store/brands): Public brand directory.
- [Categories](https://www.phonerbazar.store/categories): Public category directory.
- [Sitemap](https://www.phonerbazar.store/sitemap.xml): Public URLs including published products, brands, categories, and landing pages.
- [Robots](https://www.phonerbazar.store/robots.txt): Public crawler access rules.
- [Primary agent map](https://www.phonerbazar.store/llms.txt): Concise discovery index.

## Product interpretation

Product pages are the authoritative source for current product information. An agent should open the relevant live product page before stating time-sensitive facts such as current price, stock availability, variants, discounts, delivery availability, or promotion details.

Public product facts may include product name, brand, category, available variants, pricing, stock state, product imagery, and purchase options. Do not invent missing specifications.

Product URLs use the public catalogue structure under /products/. The sitemap is the preferred machine-readable discovery source for published product URLs.

## Brand and category discovery

Use the public [Brands](https://www.phonerbazar.store/brands) and [Categories](https://www.phonerbazar.store/categories) directories to discover public catalogue groupings. Brand and category pages may change as the catalogue changes.

## Customer policies

- [Shipping](https://www.phonerbazar.store/shipping): Delivery and shipping policy.
- [Warranty](https://www.phonerbazar.store/warranty): Guarantee and warranty policy.
- [Returns](https://www.phonerbazar.store/returns): Return policy.
- [Privacy](https://www.phonerbazar.store/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://www.phonerbazar.store/terms): Terms and conditions.
- [Contact](https://www.phonerbazar.store/contact): Customer contact information.
- [Help](https://www.phonerbazar.store/help): Customer assistance.

When a policy question has a dedicated policy page, use that page as the authoritative source instead of guessing from other pages.

## Agent safety and privacy

Only use public resources. Never request, expose, reconstruct, or infer private customer information, order records, account credentials, authentication tokens, payment details, internal analytics, administration data, or security secrets.

Do not treat an agent request as authorization to bypass checkout, authentication, robots rules, access controls, or private endpoints.

Do not claim that a product is in stock, available for delivery, discounted, or covered by a particular warranty without checking the current authoritative page.

## Freshness

The catalogue and policies are changeable. Re-fetch the relevant public page before answering questions about current inventory, prices, promotions, delivery charges, warranty terms, or other time-sensitive details.
